faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

Do you work as an interior architect for showroom design near Pitampura?

Yes. We design showrooms in Pitampura, Netaji Subhash Place, Rohini and other commercial areas of North and West Delhi.

How do you make a showroom stand out in a busy market?

A clear façade, strong signage, a bright entry and a hero display that is visible from the road draw people in.

Can you design a showroom with an office inside?

Yes. We separate the selling floor from the office, store and staff areas so customers see a clean, focused display.

Why hire an interior architect for showroom design and not just a fit-out team?

Planning decides how customers move, what they see first and how products are lit. A fit-out team builds the plan, so the plan has to be right.
